guard: Read standing restrictions separately from current wording; include powders, broths, sauces and garnish; check if servings and available ingredients are actually known.
judgment: Latest user request alone cannot override configured dietary exclusions; vegetarian does not imply vegan and onion-free does not automatically ban eggs, dairy or garlic.
transform: Preserve the dish's intended culinary role with feasible substitutions, quantities, sequence, temperature and approximate time; when traditional form is impossible, label the adaptation accurately.
verification: Review every listed ingredient and hidden derivatives, portion math, practical steps and whether a conflict or missing pantry detail was handled.
rubric: Preserve standing vegetarian and onion-free exclusions even on short prompts and explicit conflicts.
Exclude meat, fish, stock and sauce derivatives, onion powder, leek, scallion and shallot; do not ban eggs, dairy or garlic without an additional rule.
Handle conflicts without silently modifying configuration and without refusing a workable compliant alternative.
Provide quantities, serving sizes and workable cooking order, time and temperature.
Do not invent the user's pantry or assert actions that did not take place.
examples: Four-portion eggplant meal with an ingredient list and feasible steps, without onion or meat.
antiPatterns: Uses onion powder, scallion or fish sauce in a supposedly compliant meal.
Direct user request for meat silently disables configured vegetarian restriction.
Refuses eggs/garlic because vegetarian supposedly means vegan.
Replaces recognizable eggplant bake with an irrelevant salad.
Claims pantry ingredients were checked without any inventory.

modules.requirement: Respect configured restrictions independently of latest prompt; identify hidden derivatives and valid portions; treat user conflict as a request for clarification or a compliant option.
Check that the final ingredient list contains no meat, poultry, fish, onion or shallot.

checks.requirement: judge: Inspect listed food ingredients, seasonings, sauce bases, broths and garnishes against the active vegetarian/onion-free restrictions; ignore negated exclusion warnings, and do not invent additional restrictions.
